# Glyph block font_glyph_block_3, written by tools/osd_gen.py; see docs/OSD-TEXT.md.
# Its record (font_glyph_block_3, RAM 0xA80240C8, flash 0xEC0C8 in the start values) holds the packed size, the
# kind, the destination address in the menu layer memory and the address of the data. The record
# lies outside the menu area, so the data keeps its address and its packed size (4876 bytes).
# The data is sent run-length packed (osd_ram_write_packed_block): a 0x00 or 0xFF byte is
# followed by a repeat count. The build packs the bytes below again.
